results.note: De translatione S. Stephani (translation of St. Stephen's relics): No English translation found. Latin text exists in Patrologia Latina vol. 41. Limited scholarship on this anonymous narrative.
De judicio Domini (On the Judgment of the Lord): Latin text found on Wikisource but no English translation located despite searching multiple patristic databases and collections.
Genesis (Patristic biblical commentary): Not found in standard patristic translation collections (ANF, NPNF, FOTC). Anonymous biblical commentary with no identified English version.
Sodoma (On Sodom): No English translation identified in patristic translation indexes or specialist resources.
Acta procunsularia: Official record format of trials. Similar works exist in translation (e.g., Acta Proconsularia Cypriani), but this specific anonymous version's translation status is unclear.
De rebaptismate: English translation in ANF 5 (Roberts & Donaldson, Edinburgh 1867); also available at EWTN with error corrections by Electronic Bible Society. Public domain.
Fragmentum acephalum de canone scripturarum (Fragment on the Canon): No English translation found in standard collections. Academic treatment exists but no published translation located.
Passio SS. Perpetuae et Felicitatis: Multiple modern English translations including Farrell & Williams (OUP 2012) and Heffernan edition. Copyrighted contemporary translations.
Passio altera S. Cypriani (Second Passion of St. Cyprian): No dedicated English translation identified despite searching martyr acta collections.
Prooemium (Preface): Too brief (76 words) and context-dependent for independent translation identification.
Tractatus adversus Novitianum haereticum (Against the Novatian heretic): No English translation found in patristic databases or academic catalogs.

Adversus Judaeos (Against the Jews): Multiple patristic works with this title exist (Chrysostom, Tertullian, others); unclear whether this specific anonymous version PL 4 has an independent translation.
Carmen de resurrectione (Poem on the Resurrection): Lucie Martin edition (Corpus Christianorum Series Latina) references but no English translation located.
De Montibus Sina et Sion: English translation by Anni Maria Laato (Åbo Akademi, 1998); also online translation by Stephen C. Carlson. Modern academic translation.
De disciplina et bono pudicitiae (On Discipline and Chastity): No English translation identified in patristic translation projects.
De duplici martyrio (On Martyrdom, Double?): No English translation found despite its substantial length (8,648 words).
De revelatione (On Revelation): No English translation located in standard patristic collections.
Carmen adversus gentes (Poem Against the Pagans): Related works by Commodian exist with translations, but this specific anonymous work's translation status is unclear with no confirmed version.
Praefatio (Preface, appearing in volumes 5 and 77): Too fragmentary and contextual to identify translation status independently.
De laudibus Domini (On the Praise of the Lord): Latin text on Wikisource but no English translation identified.
Carmen de passione Domini (Poem on the Passion of the Lord): No English translation found despite searching patristic poetry collections.
Disquisitiones dogmaticae in Lactantium (Dogmatic discussions on Lactantius): Cataloged in Patrologia Latina but no English translation identified.
Gesta Liberii (Deeds of Pope Liberius, 6th-century account): Passages translated in academic works, but no comprehensive published English translation of the full text identified.

Panegyricus Constantini: English translation in C.E.V. Nixon & B.S. Rodgers, 'In Praise of Later Roman Emperors: The Panegyrici Latini' (1994, with original Latin by Mynors). Modern copyrighted edition.
Summa librorum sequentium (Summary of following books): No English translation identified in patristic or medieval translation collections.
Missae S. Zenonis (Masses of St. Zenonis from ancient sacramentaries): Liturgical text preserved in manuscripts but no English translation located.
Breviarium fidei adversus Arianos (Summary of faith against Arians): Cataloged in patristic collections (PL 13) but no English translation identified.
Expositio fidei: While Athanasius has an 'Expositio Fidei' with English translations (e.g., via R.P. Casey), this work is by Auctor incertus; translation status of the anonymous version unclear.
Fragmenta alia sermonum (Other sermon fragments): No English translation of this anonymous fragment collection identified.
Fragmenta sermonum Arianorum (Fragments of Arian sermons): Cataloged in Patrolog Latina Database but no English translation identified.
Fragmentum contra Arianos (Fragment against Arians): No English translation found despite searching anti-Arian patristic literature.
Natales aliquot Sanctorum (Lives of certain saints): No English translation identified in hagiographic collections.

Professio fidei S. Luciferi (Profession of faith of St. Lucifer): While 'Professio fidei' exists as a liturgical formula with translations, this specific 4th-century work's translation status is unclear.
Sermones dominicales (Sermons for Sundays): No English translation identified in homily or sermon collections.
Vita et institutum (Life and institution/practice): No English translation found despite searching hagiographic and monastic literature.
Acta S. Sebastiani (Acts of St. Sebastian): While Sebastian hagiography exists, search of major patristic sources found no English translation of this specific Acts version.
Ad virginem devotam (To a devoted virgin): Latin text on Wikisource but no published English translation located despite searching patristic addresses and feminine piety literature.
De Spiritu Sancto (On the Holy Spirit): While many patristic works on Holy Spirit theology exist in translation, this specific anonymous work has no identified English version.
De Trinitate (On the Trinity): Many works titled 'De Trinitate' exist in English (Augustine, Hilary, etc.), but this anonymous version's translation status is not confirmed.
De XLII mansionibus (On the Forty-two encampments of Israel): While Jerome and Ambrose have works with this title, this specific anonymous version has no identified English translation.
De concordia Matthaei et Lucae (On the agreement of Matthew and Luke): No English translation identified in biblical commentary or harmony literature.

De dignitate conditionis humanae: English translation in Lebech, McEvoy, and Flood article 'De dignitate conditionis humanae: Translation, Commentary, and Reception History' published in Viator (2009). Academic translation.

De dignitate sacerdotali (On the dignity of the priesthood): Pseudo-Ambrose work with English translations mentioned in scholarly literature, but translation status of this specific anonymous version unclear.

De fide orthodoxa contra Arianos: While Ambrose has 'De fide orthodoxa contra Arianos' translated by Martyn (Cambridge Scholars 2008), this work is by Auctor incertus; unclear if same work or related text.
De moribus Brachmanorum (On the customs of Brahmins): Based on/related to Palladius; no complete English translation of the anonymous version identified despite academic interest.
